in_marathi.name: Raghunandan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who takes refuge in Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raghunandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raghunandan is a compound name consisting of two parts: Raghupati (Rama's feet) and Anand (bliss). The name signifies taking refuge in Rama, who embodies strength, courage, and protection. It is a tribute to Lord Rama, the revered deity in Hinduism and the central character of the epic Ramayana.
